subject: general
question: The mean and mode of a set of data are 58.7 and 61.1, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula.
solution:
**Given:**

Mean (M) = 58.7

Mode = 61.1

**Formula used:**

Using the empirical relationship: Mean - Mode = 3(Mean - Median)

**Calculations:**

58.7 - 61.1 = 3(58.7 - Median)

⇒ - 2.4 = 3(58.7 - Median)

⇒ - 2.4 / 3 = 58.7 - Median

⇒ - 0.8 = 58.7 - Median

⇒ Median = 58.7 + 0.8

⇒ Median = 59.5

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
